extracted.name: Whole Wheat Pancake Mix
extracted.description: Keep a container of this handy homemade whole wheat pancake mix in your pantry for quick pancakes or waffles anytime you get a craving.
instruction_lines: Whisk whole wheat flour, all-purpose flour, sugar, baking powder, baking soda, and salt together in a bowl; store in an airtight container.
